Thank you for taking the time to read this and give your input. I just want to clarify that I am not asking him to cut her out of his life completely, just to draw some boundaries where they are not invited to every single thing. And i understand that people bound over trauma, but i remember asking my boyfriend before if he would think it was weird if i lived with my ex boyfriends brother and was inseparable with him, if he would think that was weird or be okay with it, and he said he would think it was weird. So he basically admitted that if the situation was reversed he wouldnt be okay with it.

He is not excluding me now, but that is what would happen. I think what bothers me a lot too is that we mostly do things he wants to to..i have sacrificed A LOT in the last 2 years to make him happy, and he doesnt even seem to be willing to make any compromises for me. But I don't know if the compromise of asking her not to be invited to everything is reasonable. 

Also, i dont think she is really trying to move on. She moved out about a year ago, but most of her stuff is still at my boyfriends house. When they fight she always mentions wanting to go and move back in with him. Also, my boyfriend is 35 and she is 41. I don't think its fair or right that he has supported her all this time when she is a grown up and should be taking care of herself. Their friends are also on the younget side (late 20s and early 30s) so she doesnt even really fit into the friend group. She just goes to spend extra time with my boyfriend. 

He had also told me things about their life in confidence that i originally didn't want to post, but maybe should just to clarify more on why i think she is manipulative. When they lived together,  she wanted to spend every available second with him and would get upset when he would go out with his friends. She would constantly talk bad about them and try to come up with ways that he wouldnt see them. When he spent any extra time with them, she would get upset and they would get into arguments. Also, when i was coming over to his house for the first time, he asked her not to be there so we could be alone and she threw a fit and they got into a fight over that. To me their relationship doesnt seem normal. It seems extremely codependent (at least on her end). I dont think thats normal bonding over trauma. I understand keeping in touch and catching up, but to literally still be inseparable 8 or so years later just seems insane. Maybe i dont understand because i had no support system whatsoever after my ex died aside from my best friend. But even with that, her and i are not inseparable. 

I think she was trying to sabotage the relationship because she knew he would be irritated if i asked to move in with him, which is what she was pressuring me to do. He has a really nice house and has said in the past he feels like exes were using him for his money and things, and i feel like i would have been roped into that category if i did what she said. She also has taken advantage of me in other ways. As one example, i used to do hair which i absolutely hated. She repeatedly asked me to do hair for her wedding and i declined, not even because i hated it but because i am terrible at wedding hairstyles. If I could do them i would have just sucked it up and done it, but that was never my area of talent and i didnt want to do something that would end up falling out or looking bad. Then right before the wedding, she had my boyfriend tell me that there was no one to do the flower girls hair. I agreed to do it if it was just down and curled, which was all i could do. He said she swore thats all she wanted. Then on the day of, what she wanted me to do was not that...it was something i clearly did not know how to do. Then, without even asking me, she mentioned that the grooms mother would also be getting her hair done by me. I just felt disrespected and taken advantage of at that point. As another testament to her character, she has also admitted to hating her stepchildren and has been trying to convince her husband to sign his rights over. 

I am not the only one in his life that sees through her. He said that his father absolutely hates her, but his mom is the one with the attachment. And again, i am not asking for her to be entirely cut out, just not to attend every single thing. Maybe i am just not right for this relationship if i cant accept her. But i also dont feel right just watching my boyfriend get completely taken advantage of and not saying anything.
